result.topic_en: Riemann sets up the forces with which a material particle resists changes of volume and of shape (via line elements) in terms of constants a and b, then generalizes these forces to hereditary (memory) integrals with functions psi and chi over past times, and begins expressing the forces in terms of velocity differences between neighbouring points.

methods.what: Quadratic elastic energy variation in principal stretches with constants a, b (Lamé-type form)
Expression as variation of a quadratic potential
Force law tending to lengthen a line element in terms of relative volume and length change
Hereditary (memory-integral) law for rate of change of line element with kernel functions psi, chi
Force components on matter as integrals of direction cosines times dK/ds
Square of relative velocity of neighbouring points

items.english: How must the functions psi and chi be constituted so that gravitation, light and radiant heat are transmitted through the space-substance?
